name: x-api-mcp
description: Post, reply, thread, upload media and manage multiple X (Twitter) accounts through the official X API. Runs locally; tokens stay on your machine.

client_id.title: X Client ID
client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID of your own X App (console.x.com). You can also leave this empty and set it later with the set_client_id tool.

client_secret.title: X Client Secret
client_secret.description: Only for Web App (confidential) clients. Leave empty for a Native App.

tools.title: Tools to enable
tools.description: all: read and write tools. write: only posting and other write tools (reads cost money).

auth_mode.title: Authorization mode
auth_mode.description: auto detects; loopback saves the callback automatically when the browser is on this computer; paste asks you to paste the callback URL.

require_account.title: Require an explicit account for writes
require_account.description: Refuse write calls that do not name the account, to avoid posting from the wrong account.

enable_dm.title: Enable direct messages
enable_dm.description: Request DM scopes and add DM tools. Turn on only if your X App has Direct Messages permission.
